configurations._comment: Port 3011 + NEXT_DIST_DIR are BOTH load-bearing, for different reasons. Port: pm2 serves the real dashboard on 3010, so a dev server there fights it. NEXT_DIST_DIR: `next dev` rewrites distDir in place REGARDLESS of --port, so without this it silently destroys the prod build pm2 is serving (empty BUILD_ID, no static/css/ -> 200 HTML + 400 on every stylesheet -> raw unstyled page while health checks still say 'up'). That took the dashboard down twice on 2026-07-17 (02:59, then again ~06:00 on a trading morning). Changing the port alone does NOT fix it.
configurations.name: dashboard
